text:
Sentence 1: Amid the celebrations, the mayor handed the key to the city to the visiting dignitary.

Main Verb: handed

- Amid the celebrations: Adjunct (Time/Context)
- the mayor: Agent (Subject)
- the key: Theme (Direct Object)
- to the city: Recipient/Goal (Indirect Object)
- to the visiting dignitary: Recipient/Goal (Indirect Object)

Sentence 2: Remind me, what is the color of grass during summer?

Main Verb: is (in the embedded clause "what is the color...") / Remind (in the main clause)

For the main clause "Remind me":
- Remind: Predicate
- me: Patient/Experiencer (Indirect Object)

For the embedded clause "what is the color of grass during summer":
- what: Theme (Subject)
- is: Copula
- the color of grass: Predicate Nominal
- during summer: Adjunct (Time)
